senses.meaning: Near; a short spatial distance from a stated or understood reference point
senses.usage_note: Use thal to name the reference point. Near/far do not by themselves specify route length, travel time, contact, or reachability. See GR-DQL1-0001.

senses.meaning: Far; a long spatial distance from a stated or understood reference point
senses.usage_note: Use thal to name the reference point. Near/far do not by themselves specify route length, travel time, contact, or reachability. See GR-DQL1-0001.

senses.meaning: At least; the stated quantity or any greater quantity, including the stated boundary
senses.usage_note: Place directly before the number and its noun or measure phrase. The boundary itself is included. See GR-DQL1-0003.

senses.meaning: At most; the stated quantity or any smaller quantity, including the stated boundary
senses.usage_note: Place directly before the number and its noun or measure phrase. The boundary itself is included. See GR-DQL1-0003.

senses.meaning: How far; closing question particle in the spatial distance question arin ... sha?
senses.usage_note: In ra rinaen [place] arin [thal reference] sha?, asks the degree of spatial separation without assuming the place is far. Limited distance construction; see GR-DQL1-0002. The established manner/method use remains valid.
